notes:
Smoother updates, a block gumball on its base point and tidier windows.

### New
- The Objects window has an eye next to the lock to show or hide a single object.

### Improved
- Installing an update asks to save your work first, before downloading, and then restarts without further questions.
- Settings with a live preview (Preferences, Grid settings, 3D mouse) dim the background only slightly, so you can see the effect.
- Floating windows align their titles, text and row buttons along the same margins.

### Fixed
- The Preferences window shows its title, close button and all tabs again.
- The gumball of a block sits on its base point instead of between its objects.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
